Canada is experiencing a severe housing crisis. Working with colleagues at the [Laurier Institute for the Study of Public Opinion and Policy](https://lispop.ca), I have begun looking at the politics and economics of housing policy, particularly in Ontario.

```{r}
# Locate the project root, then source the shared listing helper.
find_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  dir <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = FALSE)
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_quarto.yml"))) {
    parent <- dirname(dir)
    if (identical(parent, dir)) stop("Could not locate _quarto.yml")
    dir <- parent
  }
  dir
}
source(file.path(find_root(), "R_scripts", "project_listings.R"))

# Publications whose Zotero tags match this project.
render_project_pubs("Housing")
```
